Use case: precise-object-edit. One corrected complete 65:67 portrait card. Image 1 is the exact rejected fullsize generated PNG to edit; Image 2 is the exact unchanged original small card, the sole garment/pose/composition authority; Image 3 is the user mascot identity only.
Correct ONLY the long pointed yellow neck/chin funnel and its narrow shirt collar fit. Reshape the lower mascot head to a COMPACT NEAR-ROUND head with a clearly rounded chin. Bring the existing shirt collar and shoulder line UP and broaden it so the rounded chin IMMEDIATELY meets a VERY SHORT BROAD neckline. Remove the elongated tapered yellow V/triangle extending down between the shirt points. No distinct vertical yellow neck stalk and no pinched narrow human neck opening. Preserve the source OPEN dark-green military jacket, LIGHT GREY SHIRT and DARK TIE; keep their actual style and fastening. Front shirt/collar cloth overlaps the very short broad neck base, rear cloth sits behind it with coherent seam/contact shadow. Keep the tie visible below the raised collar. Do not replace the open jacket with a closed tunic, add a scarf or cream mascot-belly bib, clip fabric or leave floating collar parts.
Keep all already correct features: source head angle, green-ringed black eyes, stern closed mascot mouth, thin dark upper-lip moustache and clean chin, short dark hair and real brow hair, dark green peaked cap with its small gold drop-shaped crown badge area, embroidered gold band/dark visor, green-gold source-visible uniform decoration. Preserve the original lighting, complete tilted dark photo frame, opaque grey backing, overlapping lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and exact crop/overlap. All subject/clothing/backing/note surfaces remain opaque; genuine transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. No added readable text, symbols, figures, labels, watermark or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
